title: The Wildebeest Crossing
text: A herd of wildebeest crosses the river in a thundering, bellowing mass, churning the water brown. Crocodiles wait in the shallows, still as logs. Every so often one of the herd goes under and does not come up.

options.label: Wait for the herd to pass while the crocodiles eat their fill.

outcomes.text: After hours the river is calm and the crocodiles fat and lazy. You cross rested by the wait.

options.label: Cross in the middle of the herd, where the crocodiles have better things to eat.

outcomes.text: The crocodiles are busy with the herd.

options.label: The sharpest watches for a safe ford, away from the logs that are not logs.

outcomes.text: Upstream, where there are no crocodiles, they find it.
